column3: Triangolo Chair | Stainless Steel
column5: Triangolo Chair | Stainless Steel
column33: Triangolo Chair, initially conceived by Per Holland Bastrup in 1989 and crafted from stainless steel, is a durable seating item with an industrial aesthetic. The chair features a striking triangular seat, three sleek legs, and a curved tubular backrest. This expressive and sculptural item straddles the line between function and form, serving as seating at a desk or table or as a display piece.
column34: Mix between function and form: works well as a regular chair, or as a display piece | Designed in 1989 | Solid construction | Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use
